original.subject: [URGENT] Final SIS Proof Test Confirmation — TS-EWS-01
original.body:
This is a final verification of the SIS logic integrity on TS-EWS-01 for Teague Valley Chemical Company, Corbin Falls Works.

All SIFs (SIF-110, SIF-120, SIF-210, SIF-301, SIF-302, SIF-510, SIF-650) have been tested under controlled conditions and passed. The system is now in a validated, pre-restart state.

Running logic version: v2.1.6
Approved archive version: v2.1.6 (FPD-6.3-F-4)
Checksum match: PASSED

No changes were made to the control logic. The EHS Manager must confirm no residual risk before any restart request is submitted.

This completes the pre-startup safety review (PSSR) for the SIS. The unit may not be restarted until the PSSR is signed and the Plant Manager has approved.

Contact: 1-800-424-8802 (Schneider Electric OT Support) — Reference: TVCC-OTSEC-2026-SIS-001

Schneider Electric – OT Systems Support
Global Control Systems Division
Verified via TVC-JMP-02 and TS-EWS-01
Approved by: S. Rostov, Lead Systems Engineer, 2026-1024-1208-0047
